Join us for an unforgettable evening as we celebrate “America’s best idea” - our National Parks - and the 30th Anniversary of Oregon Parks Forever, with a special screening of the award-winning documentary, Out There: A National Parks Story. A discussion with the filmmaker will follow. Director & Cinematographer Brendan Hall and a childhood friend will take you on a breathtaking 10,000-mile journey through the heart of 15 of America’s national parks, capturing the landscapes, the people, and the powerful stories that define these treasured places.
